reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset, and Brown attribute Arah's 775-versus-652 gap to death, illness, and delay thinning an initial Babylon enrollment before arrival.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible, "How many of Arah's offspring returned from Babylon?" (skepticsannotatedbible.com/contra/arah.html) (2013).
